programme.title: Cole Younger, Gunfighter
programme.desc: A notorious outlaw (Frank Lovejoy) helps a cowboy (James Best) fight political corruption in 1873 Texas.

programme.title: The Cowboys
programme.desc: An aging rancher is forced to hire a group of schoolboys when his own men desert him before a 400-mile cattle drive.

programme.title: The Train Robbers
programme.desc: A proud widow hires a Civil War veteran to help recover the gold her late husband stole from Wells Fargo.

programme.title: Wild Stallion
programme.desc: Raised by a cowboy (Edgar Buchanan) at a cavalry fort, an orphan becomes an officer (Ben Johnson) and looks for his long-lost horse.

programme.title: The Big Trees
programme.desc: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone.

programme.title: The Hanging Tree
programme.desc: A doctor (Gary Cooper) kills to save a blinded Swiss girl (Maria Schell) from a villain (Karl Malden) in a Montana gold-mining town.

programme.title: Springfield Rifle
programme.desc: A Union major (Gary Cooper) with a wife (Phyllis Thaxter) and son goes undercover as a traitor to stop a Confederate raider (David Brian).

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A lawman (Dwight Yoakam) protecting a small Southwestern town wants revenge on a family of troublemakers that earlier disgraced him.

programme.title: 6 Bullets to Hell
programme.desc: After his wife is murdered by bandit Bobby Durango (Tanner Beard), Billy Rogers (Crispian Belfrage) takes out his old gun and hunts the gang down one by one.

programme.title: Deadman Standing
programme.desc: A widowed lawman befriends a dying boy and the madam of a brothel as the town is being overtaken by a deadly gang of cattlemen.

programme.title: The Fastest Guitar Alive
programme.desc: A Rebel spy (Roy Orbison) with a shotgun guitar robs a mint with his partner (Sammy Jackson), then learns Lee has surrendered.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.

programme.title: Kansas Pacific
programme.desc: Southern sympathizers block an Army engineer (Sterling Hayden) building a railway to the West in 1860.

programme.title: Honky-Tonk
programme.desc: A con man in the West of the 1880s sets his sights on the gold strike in Cascade, Nev., but is beaten at his own game.

programme.title: The Sacketts
programme.desc: The Sackett brothers seek their fortunes out west after the Civil War.

programme.title: The Sacketts
programme.desc: The Sackett brothers seek their fortunes out west after the Civil War.

programme.title: Crossfire Trail
programme.desc: A hardened drifter (Tom Selleck) promises his dying friend that he will protect the man's wife (Virginia Madsen) and daughter, and their Wyoming homestead.

programme.title: 3:10 to Yuma
programme.desc: A rancher (Christian Bale) and the captive outlaw (Russell Crowe) in his charge learn to respect each other on a dangerous journey to catch a train.

programme.title: The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing
programme.desc: A Wells Fargo detective (Lee J. Cobb) tracks an outlaw (Burt Reynolds) and his captive (Sarah Miles), who is fleeing from her husband.

programme.title: Apache War Smoke
programme.desc: Indians chase a Mexican bandit (Gilbert Roland) to his long-lost son's (Robert Horton) stage station.

programme.title: Along the Great Divide
programme.desc: A U.S. marshal (Kirk Douglas) leads a lynch-mob survivor, his daughter (Virginia Mayo) and others across the desert to justice.

programme.title: Somewhere in Sonora
programme.desc: When Bishop is framed for cheating during a competition and is jailed, Bob Leadly, who runs the rodeo, gets him out. Bishop agrees to accompany Leadly to Mexico to find the man's son, Bart, who is rumored to be riding with a gang of horse thieves.

programme.title: The Man From Monterey
programme.desc: To solidify the American presence in newly acquired California, the U.S. government assigns Capt. John Holmes and his trusty horse, Duke, to notify settlers that the government needs them to register any land acquired under Spanish rule.

programme.title: There Was a Crooked Man
programme.desc: A killer convict (Kirk Douglas) betrays the new warden (Henry Fonda) of an Arizona territorial prison.

programme.title: Drum Beat
programme.desc: President Grant gives a frontiersman (Alan Ladd) the power to make peace with Indians roused by a renegade.

programme.title: The Train Robbers
programme.desc: A proud widow hires a Civil War veteran to help recover the gold her late husband stole from Wells Fargo.

programme.title: Dodge City
programme.desc: A Texas cattle agent witnesses first hand the brutal lawlessness of Dodge City and takes the job of sheriff to clean the town up.

programme.title: Montana
programme.desc: An Australian sheepman (Errol Flynn) tangles with a cattlewoman (Alexis Smith) who does not want sheep on her land.

programme.title: Virginia City
programme.desc: A Union spy (Errol Flynn), a Rebel spy (Randolph Scott), a saloon singer (Miriam Hopkins) and an outlaw vie for a wagon train of Confederate gold in Nevada.

programme.title: Wild Rovers
programme.desc: An old cowboy (William Holden) and his young partner (Ryan O'Neal) try to finance a dream ranch by robbing a bank.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: A cowboy (John Wayne) romances a pretty woman (Marion Burns) while tracking the outlaw gang that killed his father.

programme.title: Tension at Table Rock
